description: This file defines the PowerpointLoader class, a specialized document loader for PowerPoint files that uses officeparser to extract slide content and metadata, splitting the content into individual slides.

classes.name: PowerpointLoader
classes.description: A class extending BufferLoader to load and parse PowerPoint documents into individual slide documents with metadata.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Asynchronously parses raw PowerPoint data into an array of Document objects, extracting slide content and metadata.

methods.name: splitIntoSlides
methods.description: Splits the extracted text content into individual slides based on common patterns or heuristics.
